question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to 100 words.
guide_solution: 'Lady with the lamp', Florence Nightingale was born in Florence, Italy. As she felt God was calling her to serve the humanity, she wanted to nurse the sick. She went to Kaiserwerh in Germany to learn nursing. She was determined to sacrifice herself. For his work, even now people remember him with great respect.
